title: RawContent
description: Immutable, versioned raw content record for news, announcements, research, interactive and social content. publishTime and ingestTime are distinct (publication vs Kunlun ingest); the content fingerprint is deterministic and algorithm-versioned; updates and deletions never overwrite history.

contentType.description: Content category: NEWS / ANNOUNCEMENT / RESEARCH / INTERACTION / SOCIAL

url.description: Original URL or source locator for the raw content

publishTime.description: When the content was published (timezone-aware, never later than ingestTime)

fingerprintAlgorithmVersion.description: Algorithm version used to compute the fingerprint

originalSource.description: Original source for a repost; absent for non-repost content

previousFingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the version this record supersedes; absent for the first version

deleted.description: Whether this content has been deleted; deletion preserves evidence

deletedAt.description: Deletion time (timezone-aware); required when deleted is true

ContentSource.description: Attribution of content to its source (id / version / evidence)

evidenceId.description: Immutable identifier of the raw evidence this content derives from

LicenseMetadata.description: License and usage-restriction metadata; empty strings never stand in for 'no restriction'

usageRestriction.description: Usage restriction; a non-restricting license states it explicitly

authorized.description: Whether use of the content is authorized
